priority.P0: Blocks daily use or the first wins (Phases 0-2)
priority.P2: Optional retained scope in this release; may slip without blocking release
priority.P3: Deferred to a later release; kept for traceability

field_definitions.phase: 0 Hardware truth and setup; 1 Markup core; 2 First wins; 3 Precision, capture, sync; 4 Remote edit and monitor; 5 Verification, tunnel, release

origin.owner: Owner asked for it in the 2026-09-30/10-01 decisions
origin.spec-v1: Carried from the v1 package (including new IDs split out of a v1 requirement so each gate can pass)

owner_decision.v1-accepted: Accepted in the v1 package (owner request or recommended default; v1 did not distinguish)
owner_decision.default-accepted: Recommended default; owner accepted the plan

field_definitions.evidence: Paths under docs/evidence/ added when verification runs

requirements.title: Shared versioned document with immutable originals
requirements.statement: Both devices edit one project document through the host-sequenced op log. Original assets are immutable and content-addressed.
acceptance: An edit committed on either device appears on the other with an identical state hash within PERF-002 limits.
Original asset bytes hash identically (BLAKE3) before and after 1,000 random edit and undo operations.
No code path writes into blobs/ except to add a new asset (code review plus test).
requirements.v1_note: updated: mechanism defined by D1, D3 and D5

requirements.title: Independent per-device views
requirements.statement: Zoom, pan, rotation, lens and tool state belong to each device and never change because of a peer's edit. Follow-peer and match-view are explicit commands.
acceptance: Across 100 random peer edits the receiving device's camera state is bit-identical before and after.
Follow-peer and match-view exist as explicit commands and are off by default.
evidence: docs/evidence/T1.01.md — shared camera and transforms verified on Windows/S23; receiving camera invariance across 100 peer edits and explicit default-off follow/match remain T1.09, T1.10 and T1.12.

requirements.title: Live in-progress edits
requirements.statement: Strokes, shape drags, handle moves, slider changes and selection edits stream to the peer as provisional gesture updates while in progress.
acceptance: The PC shows an in-progress phone stroke before pen-up, updating at >= 30 Hz over USB.
Handle drags and slider moves show intermediate states on the peer, not only the final state.
Provisional updates never appear in history or undo.
requirements.v1_note: updated: selection edits stream from Phase 2

requirements.title: Local pen feedback independent of network and AI
requirements.statement: Wet ink renders locally before any network or AI work and keeps rendering while the link is down.
acceptance: With the network disconnected, wet-ink latency still meets PERF-001.
No blocking network or AI call exists on the input-to-render path (trace review).

requirements.title: Transactional undo/redo and cancelled provisional edits
requirements.statement: Each gesture commits exactly one undoable transaction; a cancelled gesture commits nothing anywhere.
acceptance: Each gesture commits exactly one transaction.
Undo and redo restore identical state hashes across 500 random sequences (property test).
A cancelled gesture leaves no committed edit on either device (A06).

requirements.title: Stable revision, source and frame identity
requirements.statement: Every export, package, AI request and capture carries its revision, source asset hash and, for captures, capture session and frame IDs.
acceptance: Every exported file's metadata includes revision r{seq}-{hash8} and the source asset hash (package manifests carry them under PKG-001 and EXPORT-008).
Capture documents record CaptureSessionId, FrameId and CaptureGeometry (model and storage tests; exercised end to end by CAPTURE-001).
requirements.v1_note: unchanged intent; acceptance limited to Phase 1 exports and capture records; packages are verified by PKG-001 and EXPORT-008

requirements.title: Reconnection without duplicate operations
requirements.statement: Reconnects and retries never apply a transaction twice or lose one.
acceptance: vw-sim: 10,000 seeded runs with drop, duplicate, reorder and partition faults end with identical state hashes on both devices and zero duplicated or lost transactions.
Hardware: unplugging USB mid-gesture and reconnecting yields no duplicate commit.

requirements.title: Project save, reopen and crash recovery
requirements.statement: Projects persist continuously; a crash loses at most the in-progress gesture.
acceptance: Killing the writing process mid-edit loses at most the in-progress gesture, and reopening restores the last committed state hash (store crash tests; app kills are re-checked in A18).
Fixture projects from every previous schema version reopen with identical state after migration; fixtures use synthetic device IDs and labels.

requirements.title: Multiple documents and bookmarked regions
requirements.statement: A project holds many documents; named region bookmarks restore a view.
acceptance: A project holds >= 20 documents; switching documents keeps each document's per-device view.
Named region bookmarks restore the view exactly on each device.

requirements.title: Stylus pressure and cancellation
requirements.statement: Stylus pressure drives stroke width through the active pressure curve; palm and cancelled pointers never commit ink.
acceptance: Pressure reaches stroke width per the active curve; raw and normalized values appear in diagnostics.
Palm touches and ACTION_CANCEL / FLAG_CANCELED pointers never commit ink (A06).
requirements.v1_note: split: hover moved to PEN-013, tilt/orientation to PEN-014

requirements.title: Configurable pressure curve, cursor and stabilization
requirements.statement: Each brush has an editable pressure curve, a width cursor and adjustable stabilization.
acceptance: The pressure curve is editable (Bezier) with live preview and stored per brush; a sensible default ships in Phase 1.
Stabilization 0-1 measurably changes smoothing on replayed fixtures.
A brush cursor shows the stroke width while hovering (when hover exists).

requirements.title: Pen draws, fingers navigate by default
requirements.statement: By default the pen uses the active tool and fingers navigate.
acceptance: With default settings, pen input never pans and finger input never draws.
Finger drawing can be enabled in settings.

requirements.title: Contact-following inspection loupe
requirements.statement: An offset magnifier follows the pen while it touches the canvas without changing input mapping.
acceptance: The loupe appears within one frame of contact, above-left by default for right-handed use, avoids screen edges, and never covers the nib point.
Replayed traces produce identical stroke geometry with the loupe on and off.

requirements.title: Pen-button precision lens preserving the base view
requirements.statement: A barrel-button toggle opens an editable inset at 2x, 4x or 8x; closing it restores the base view exactly.
acceptance: Edits inside the lens land at correct document coordinates at every supported scale.
Closing the lens restores the base camera bit-identically.

requirements.title: Latched lens transform
requirements.statement: The lens transform is fixed for the duration of a stroke.
acceptance: All samples of a stroke map through the transform latched at pen-down (property test over random transforms).
evidence: docs/evidence/T1.01.md — 10,000-case lens latch property suite per platform; math evidence only, product lens behavior remains T3.04.

requirements.title: Lens scale, placement, smooth and pixel-grid rendering
requirements.statement: Lens magnification, position, size and rendering mode are configurable.
acceptance: Scale, position and size are configurable; nearest-neighbor pixel-grid and smooth modes both exist.

requirements.title: No transform jump on a mid-stroke toggle
requirements.statement: A lens toggle requested during a stroke applies at pen-up.
acceptance: Across 200 replayed traces with a toggle mid-stroke: no connector segment, no coordinate jump, no duplicate commit.

requirements.title: Barrel button and Air Actions event separation
requirements.statement: The barrel button is read from MotionEvent button state; Air Actions arrive as KeyEvents; one physical action triggers one command.
acceptance: Barrel state comes from MotionEvent.buttonState, Air Actions from KeyEvents, and no single physical action triggers two commands.

requirements.title: Configurable Air Actions
requirements.statement: Single, double, swipe and circle Air Actions map to remappable commands (S23 Ultra only).
acceptance: All supported Air Actions are remappable; defaults follow BUILD_SPECIFICATION section 4.16.

requirements.title: Capability onboarding and visible fallbacks
requirements.statement: Onboarding detects Air Actions availability and Air Command interference; every gesture command has an on-screen equivalent.
acceptance: Onboarding explains enabling Air Actions and disabling Air Command's button trigger.
Every gesture-triggered command also exists as a visible control.

requirements.title: Deduplicated routes and no implicit submission
requirements.statement: No gesture, button or Air Action sends a package, submits a chat or applies an AI result.
acceptance: Sending, submitting and applying always require an explicit on-screen confirmation (test every input route).

requirements.title: Hover position and in-range state
requirements.statement: Hover position and in-range state drive the cursor and loupe when the device reports hover.
acceptance: Hover updates drive the cursor and loupe at the device's hover rate.
Without hover support, hover features hide gracefully.
evidence: docs/evidence/T0.04.md: Recorder and measurement tools prepared. S23 physical hover, tilt/orientation calibration and ten-minute drawing temperature baseline are unmeasured; injected OnePlus data does not establish those capabilities. Status unchanged; owning later tasks and T0.12 remain responsible for acceptance.

requirements.title: Tilt and orientation when reported
requirements.statement: When the stylus reports tilt and orientation, they are recorded in strokes and passed to Windows injection.
acceptance: If T0.04 shows tilt axes, tilt and orientation appear in stroke samples, and the BUILD_SPECIFICATION section 4.11 tiltX/tiltY conversion passes unit tests against T0.04's calibration traces (injected tilt is verified with TUNNEL-004).
If not, the capability flag is false and no feature depends on tilt.
evidence: docs/evidence/T0.04.md: Recorder and measurement tools prepared. S23 physical hover, tilt/orientation calibration and ten-minute drawing temperature baseline are unmeasured; injected OnePlus data does not establish those capabilities. Status unchanged; owning later tasks and T0.12 remain responsible for acceptance.

requirements.title: Stylus abstraction for any Android stylus
requirements.statement: All pen features read input through one abstraction with per-device capability flags; Samsung features are optional modules.
acceptance: Pressure, hover, tilt, buttons and eraser are exposed through one interface with capability flags.
The app runs fully with a generic stylus profile when no Samsung features exist (injected test events).

requirements.title: Hover-aim loupe
requirements.statement: With hover available, the loupe shows the reticle before contact so the first touch lands where intended.
acceptance: The reticle shows the predicted contact point during hover; first-contact error <= 1 screen px from the reticle on replayed traces.

requirements.title: Recorded pen-trace fixtures and replay
requirements.statement: Real S Pen traces are recorded on the device and replayed in automated tests.
acceptance: A recorder exports traces (all axes, timestamps, buttons, hover) as JSON.
Instrumentation replays traces with pressure, tilt, hover and buttons.
At least 20 owner-recorded traces are stored in fixtures/.
evidence: docs/evidence/T0.04.md: Probe recorder and bounded HIL replay implemented; physical OnePlus synthetic software checks are separate from S23 acceptance. At least 24 S23 owner traces, their replay, capability measurements and thermal session remain pending in T0.04. Public MotionEvent construction cannot reproduce nonzero actionButton; affected traces fail explicitly.

requirements.title: Pens, highlighters, arrows, lines, shapes and text
requirements.statement: Each annotation tool creates an editable object that renders identically on both devices.
acceptance: Pen, highlighter (multiply blend), marker, line, arrow, rectangle, ellipse and text tools create editable objects.
Text uses bundled fonts and renders identically on both devices and in exports (golden test).

requirements.title: Numbered markers linked to instructions
requirements.statement: Markers number themselves in placement order and each links to one instruction.
acceptance: Markers auto-number in placement order and renumber consistently after deletion.
Each marker links to exactly one instruction record.

requirements.title: Layers: visibility, order, opacity, locks and groups
requirements.statement: Layers and groups organize objects with visibility, order, opacity and locking.
acceptance: Layer visibility, order, opacity, locking and grouping sync across devices and are undoable.

requirements.title: Move, resize and editable properties
requirements.statement: Objects move and resize with handles; property edits are single undoable transactions. Rotation is EDIT-012.
acceptance: Objects move and resize with handles on both devices.
Every property edit is one undoable transaction whose intermediate states stream (CORE-003).
requirements.v1_note: split: rotation moved to EDIT-012 (phase 3) so each gate can pass

requirements.title: Stroke, object and mask erasers
requirements.statement: Erasers remove whole objects, split vector strokes, or subtract from masks.
acceptance: The object eraser deletes whole objects; the stroke eraser splits vector strokes; the mask eraser subtracts from masks; all undoable.

requirements.title: Rectangle, freehand and painted selections
requirements.statement: Selections come in rectangle, freehand (lasso) and painted forms. Ellipse and polygon selections are EDIT-013.
acceptance: Rectangle, freehand lasso and painted-mask selections work on both devices.
Selections render identically on both devices.
requirements.v1_note: split: ellipse and polygon selections moved to EDIT-013 (phase 3) so each gate can pass

requirements.title: Mask math
requirements.statement: Masks support add, subtract, intersect, invert, expand, shrink and feather.
acceptance: Each operation produces a new mask version.
Results match reference implementations within 1 level per pixel (golden tests).

requirements.title: Change, preserve, reference and explain semantics
requirements.statement: Every marker and region carries a role independent of its appearance.
acceptance: Roles appear in packages, prompts and AI requests regardless of color.

requirements.title: Crop, rotate, resize and basic nondestructive tonal adjustment
requirements.statement: Documents support crop, rotate, resize and basic tonal adjustments without altering originals.
acceptance: Crop, rotate and resize are nondestructive and exportable; brightness, contrast and levels are parameters, never baked into originals.

requirements.title: Preserve-exterior compositing with explicit blend boundary
requirements.statement: AI results are composited only inside the feathered change mask; everything outside stays bit-identical to the source.
acceptance: Composites follow BUILD_SPECIFICATION section 4.9.2 steps 1-8.
Changed pixels outside the dilated mask = 0 on every composite.

requirements.title: Object rotation
requirements.statement: Objects rotate with a handle; each rotation is one undoable transaction.
acceptance: A rotation handle rotates objects on both devices, snapping to 15-degree steps while Shift is held (PC) or the context bar's snap toggle is on (phone).
Each rotation is one undoable transaction and renders identically on both devices and in exports (golden).
requirements.v1_note: new ID: rotation split out of v1 EDIT-004

requirements.title: Ellipse and polygon selections
requirements.statement: Selections can also be drawn as ellipses and polygons.
acceptance: Ellipse and polygon selections produce masks identical on both devices (golden) and combine with mask math (EDIT-007).
requirements.v1_note: new ID: split out of v1 EDIT-006

requirements.title: Manual correction for assisted selection
requirements.statement: Assisted selections are always editable by hand.
acceptance: Every assisted selection can be refined with add/subtract brushes and mask math before use.

requirements.title: Assisted selection on the phone
requirements.statement: A segmentation model on the phone proposes a mask from pen prompts; the image is encoded once and each prompt is fast.
acceptance: After one encoder pass per image, each pen prompt returns a mask in <= 100 ms on the S23 Ultra (NPU or GPU), with a CPU fallback.
The model and runtime licenses pass the license gate.

requirements.title: Desktop shortcut capture of the foreground window
requirements.statement: A hotkey captures the foreground window losslessly and sends it to the phone. The source picker (window, monitor, region) is CAPTURE-007.
acceptance: Ctrl+Alt+A (remappable) captures the foreground window losslessly.
A capture appears on the phone within 1 s over USB.
requirements.v1_note: split: the window/monitor/region picker moved to CAPTURE-007 (phase 3) so each gate can pass

requirements.title: Freeze the exact displayed frame at first valid markup
requirements.statement: First valid pen contact in live annotate pins the frame the phone displayed, then swaps in its lossless copy.
acceptance: With the source changing every frame, the frozen FrameId equals the last frame presented before contact in 50 of 50 trials.
The lossless copy replaces it within PERF-004.

requirements.title: One-action cancel and resume live
requirements.statement: Cancel & Resume Live discards only the current draft.
acceptance: Cancel & Resume Live returns to LIVE within 300 ms and leaves earlier saved captures untouched.

requirements.title: Frame age and frozen-state indication
requirements.statement: Both devices show LIVE with the source name, or FROZEN with the frame's age.
acceptance: FROZEN and age in seconds are visible on both devices while frozen; LIVE shows the source name.

requirements.title: No freeze-on-contact in remote edit
requirements.statement: Pen contact in remote-edit mode never freezes the view.
acceptance: 100 pen contacts in remote-edit mode produce zero freezes.

requirements.title: Prevent recursive self-capture
requirements.statement: The app's own windows never appear in its captures.
acceptance: App windows use WDA_EXCLUDEFROMCAPTURE; capturing a monitor that shows the app never shows the app's windows.
requirements.v1_note: split: source feedback loops (the scrcpy window on a streamed display) moved to CAPTURE-008 (phase 5), where that source exists

requirements.title: Capture picker: window, monitor and region
requirements.statement: A picker captures any window, monitor or drawn region; a region can also be requested from the phone.
acceptance: The picker captures a chosen window, a monitor or a drawn region losslessly; Ctrl+Alt+R (remappable) starts a region capture.
A region capture can be requested from the phone and arrives within 1 s over USB.
requirements.v1_note: new ID: picker split out of v1 CAPTURE-001

requirements.title: No capture or stream feedback loops
requirements.statement: Capturing or streaming a source that contains the app's own live output is detected and refused.
acceptance: Streaming or capturing a display or window that shows the scrcpy phone-mirror window (for example the virtual display with scrcpy on it) is detected and refused with a message; no recursive mirror forms.
requirements.v1_note: new ID: feedback-loop half of v1 CAPTURE-006

requirements.title: Windows window or monitor live view on Android
requirements.statement: A chosen Windows window or monitor streams live to the phone.
acceptance: Frame-stream live view of a chosen window or monitor at >= 15 fps over USB under the STREAM-001 test conditions.
requirements.v1_note: updated: the HEVC remote-edit view is STREAM-002 (phase 4)

requirements.title: Android live screen or app view on Windows
requirements.statement: The phone screen appears live on the PC through pinned scrcpy.
acceptance: Pinned scrcpy shows the phone screen on the PC.
Markup captures from the PC use lossless screencap plus uiautomator dump (SEM-007).

requirements.title: Separate view, control and external-transmission authority
requirements.statement: view_screen, remote_input, ai_send and agent_capture are independent grants.
acceptance: Denying or revoking one grant never disables or enables another (test per capability).

requirements.title: Authorized Windows pen, mouse and keyboard control
requirements.statement: While remote_input is granted, the phone drives the target app with native pen, mouse and keyboard input.
acceptance: In the harness window, WM_POINTER pressure tracks phone pressure (Pearson r >= 0.95).
When the stylus reports tilt, the harness logs tiltX/tiltY matching the section 4.11 conversion within 2 degrees.
Mouse and keyboard reach the target.
No input is delivered unless remote_input is GRANTED.

requirements.title: Authorized Android cross-app control without root
requirements.statement: The PC controls the phone through pinned scrcpy with explicit owner setup.
acceptance: Control works through scrcpy over USB debugging; no root; no unattended network adb port.
The app uses the adb from the owner's installed Android platform-tools; it never bundles adb.exe.

requirements.title: Suspend input on stale geometry or an invalid target
requirements.statement: Injection stops before the next event whenever the target window, focus or geometry changes.
acceptance: Moving, resizing, minimizing or switching away from the target delivers 0 events to any other window in 100 trials.
Both devices show INPUT PAUSED until the owner explicitly resumes.

requirements.title: DPI, orientation and negative-origin mapping
requirements.statement: Frame-to-host coordinate mapping is exact across DPI scales, rotations and negative monitor origins.
acceptance: Property tests map F to H exactly with negative origins, 100-300% scaling and rotated displays.

A hardware run at the laptop's own scaling maps F to H exactly; if an external monitor is available it is placed left of the laptop for a negative-origin run (otherwise DISPLAY-003 covers the negative-origin hardware run in Phase 4).
evidence: docs/evidence/T1.01.md — exact integer F/H property suite passes at 100–300% DPI and negative/rotated origins on Windows/S23; physical Windows scaling/injection mapping remains T3.01 and negative-origin display hardware remains DISPLAY-003.
requirements.v1_note: updated: negative-origin hardware run moves to the virtual display (DISPLAY-003) when no second monitor exists

requirements.title: No stale input replay after reconnection
requirements.statement: Input from a previous session is never delivered after a reconnect.
acceptance: After a reconnect or a USB <-> Wi-Fi switch during remote input, zero events from the previous InputSessionId are delivered (simulation and hardware).

requirements.title: Explicit app-aware shortcut and undo destination
requirements.statement: Undo, redo and shortcuts go to the canvas or the remote app based on a visible context.
acceptance: The active command destination (canvas or remote app) is always shown on screen.
Undo and redo go to that destination; in a remote app they send the app's own shortcuts (verified in Photoshop if installed, Krita and Paint).
requirements.v1_note: updated: full per-editor shortcut palettes are EDITOR-005 (P2)

requirements.title: USB connection with explicit authorization
requirements.statement: USB works through USB tethering (QUIC) without developer mode, and through adb (TCP-mux) as a developer option; pairing is explicit.
acceptance: Pairing and editing over USB tethering work with developer options off.
The adb carrier works with USB debugging on.
Tethering never becomes the PC's default internet route without the owner's approval.
evidence: docs/evidence/T0.06.md: Evidence only; S23 adb TCP measured 3000 verified echoes and 256 MiB at 32.41 MiB/s. Wi-Fi, USB tethering, physical recovery and Windows listener firewall acceptance remain open; echo RTT is not product latency. Implementation and verification statuses unchanged.
requirements.v1_note: updated: tethering added so normal use needs no developer mode (owner: may monetize later)

requirements.title: Local Wi-Fi without internet or account
requirements.statement: Devices pair and work over a local network with no internet and no account.
acceptance: Pairing and editing work over Wi-Fi with internet blocked at the router; no account exists anywhere.

requirements.title: Authenticated, encrypted, revocable pairing and discovery
requirements.statement: Pairing follows BUILD_SPECIFICATION section 4.7.
acceptance: QR pairing with mutual certificate pinning works; unpaired or revoked devices are refused at handshake.
mDNS TXT records contain only a random ID (unrelated to the DeviceId, rotated at each app start) and the protocol major version.
Device keys and the paired/revoked trust list live at app level (Windows: DPAPI-protected or Credential Manager; Android: Keystore-wrapped), never in project files or .vwbz exports.

requirements.title: USB media path without assuming UDP over adb
requirements.statement: MEDIA runs over QUIC on tethering and over TCP-mux on adb.
acceptance: Both carriers deliver MEDIA with latest-frame semantics: under a 2x overload from a synthetic frame source on hardware, the receiver only ever renders the newest frame per key.
evidence: docs/evidence/T0.06.md: Evidence only; S23 adb TCP measured 3000 verified echoes and 256 MiB at 32.41 MiB/s. Wi-Fi, USB tethering, physical recovery and Windows listener firewall acceptance remain open; echo RTT is not product latency. Implementation and verification statuses unchanged.

requirements.title: Bounded queues and separate recovery per channel
requirements.statement: Each channel has its own queueing and recovery policy.
acceptance: EPHEMERAL and MEDIA never queue more than one item per key; OPS are persisted; INPUT is discarded on reconnect (simulation).

requirements.title: Optional real Windows extended monitor
requirements.statement: A virtual monitor appears in Windows and streams to the phone.
acceptance: A SudoVDA monitor at 3088x1440 appears in Windows display settings and streams to the phone.

requirements.title: Driver deployment with security settings retained
requirements.statement: The driver installs, works and uninstalls with Secure Boot and Memory Integrity on.
acceptance: Install, use and uninstall succeed with Secure Boot and Memory Integrity on (T0.08 evidence); no test-signing mode.
The signing key never enters the repo.
requirements.v1_note: updated: self-signed UMDF route for personal use; Microsoft attestation (EV) before distribution

requirements.title: Selectable geometry, orientation and scaling
requirements.statement: The virtual monitor's resolution, refresh, orientation and scaling are selectable.
acceptance: Phone-native portrait and landscape modes plus custom modes are selectable; Windows scaling applies.
With the virtual display placed left of the laptop screen (negative origin) and rotated, F-to-H mapping stays exact on hardware (TUNNEL-007 cases).

requirements.title: Recover windows and topology on removal
requirements.statement: Removing the virtual monitor, deliberately or after a crash, returns its windows to a physical display.
acceptance: After normal removal or an app crash (watchdog), windows return to the physical display within 5 s with DPI restored.

requirements.title: Direct remote drawing in installed Photoshop
requirements.statement: With Photoshop installed, phone pen strokes draw in Photoshop with pressure.
acceptance: With Photoshop 27.9.1 installed, brush width or opacity varies with pen pressure; results recorded per tool.
requirements.v1_note: updated: requires the owner to install Photoshop (not installed on 2026-10-01)

requirements.title: Remote editing in Illustrator
requirements.statement: Illustrator is covered only by generic remote editing; no Illustrator-specific bridge or test plan.
acceptance: If Illustrator is installed, generic remote-edit results are recorded in the compatibility matrix; nothing else is required.
requirements.v1_note: re-scoped: owner did not select Illustrator; no UXP before spring 2027

requirements.title: Remote editing in Paint
requirements.statement: Paint is a remote-pen target; its pressure behavior is tested and recorded.
acceptance: Pointer, drawing and pressure behavior in Paint 11.2605+ are recorded in the compatibility matrix (pressure support unconfirmed).

requirements.title: Per-tool, per-version pen compatibility report
requirements.statement: Pen compatibility is reported per app, version and tool from real tests.
acceptance: docs/compat/ lists app, version, tool, pointer, pressure, tilt, eraser, shortcuts and measured latency for every tested editor.

requirements.title: Same-document independent native views
requirements.statement: Photoshop shows a second window of the same document on the virtual display at independent zoom.
acceptance: Photoshop's New Window on the virtual display shows live edits at a different zoom from the main window.
Paint has no equivalent; Illustrator is not targeted.

requirements.title: Photoshop clean-pixel and selection bridge
requirements.statement: A UXP plugin exchanges raw pixels and selections with explicit document and layer IDs.
acceptance: get_pixels returns full-resolution raw pixels with correct bounds, depth and profile.
get_selection / put_selection round-trip a mask within 1 level per pixel.

requirements.title: Return edits to an explicit document, layer and revision
requirements.statement: Results return only to the document and layer they came from.
acceptance: put_layer refuses when the target document or layer ID no longer matches; inserted layers are named with the revision.

requirements.title: No assumed layered fidelity or Paint multiview parity
requirements.statement: The product never claims layered PSD round trips or Paint multiview.
acceptance: UI text and docs make no such claims; the compatibility matrix states the limits.

requirements.title: 200-MP-class photo and long screenshot test assets
requirements.statement: Fixtures include giant photos, long screenshots, PDFs, SVGs and malformed files.
acceptance: fixtures/ holds generator scripts with fixed seeds plus SHA-256 lists for a 16320x12240 JPEG, a 1440x20000 screenshot, multipage PDFs, SVGs and malformed files, each with a provenance note; generated files over 10 MB live in git-ignored fixtures/generated/.

A real 200 MP S23 Ultra photo (JPEG, plus HEIF if the camera produces one) lives in git-ignored fixtures-private/ with location data removed; tests that need it skip with a clear message when it is absent.

requirements.title: Tiled multiresolution demand decoding and transfer
requirements.statement: Large images display from tile pyramids fetched on demand.
acceptance: A 200 MP image shows a preview within 1.5 s and fills the phone screen with full-resolution tiles within 250 ms (PERF-005).
The tile renderer's GPU texture cache stays within budget (defaults: phone 192 MB, PC 384 MB).

requirements.title: Bounded RAM, GPU and disk caches with a low-space reserve
requirements.statement: Caches stay within budgets and a disk reserve; originals are never evicted.
acceptance: RAM caches never exceed configured budgets (defaults: phone 256 MB, PC 512 MB).
A disk reserve of max(5 GB, min(5% of the drive, 10 GB)) is enforced; low space blocks caching with a message and never deletes originals.
requirements.v1_note: unchanged intent; the GPU texture budget is verified with the tile renderer in FORMAT-002 (phase 3)

requirements.title: Original resolution retained; no silent preview substitution
requirements.statement: Exports always use source resolution or say otherwise.
acceptance: Exports report source revision and resolution.
An export requested while only a preview is available is refused or clearly labelled, never silently downsampled.

requirements.title: PNG, JPEG and WebP import and export
requirements.statement: PNG, JPEG and WebP import and export on both devices with their limits checked. BMP and TIFF are FORMAT-013.
acceptance: PNG, JPEG and WebP import and export on both devices.
Round-trip tests cover alpha and 16-bit PNG.
requirements.v1_note: split: BMP and TIFF moved to FORMAT-013 (phase 3) so each gate can pass

requirements.title: Multipage PDF navigation, markup and export
requirements.statement: PDFs open with page navigation, page-indexed overlays and explicit export choices.
acceptance: Multipage PDFs open, annotate, zoom, select text and export as an annotated copy or a flattened copy.

requirements.title: Safe SVG rendering and vector export
requirements.statement: SVGs render without scripts, network or local file access; annotations export as SVG.
acceptance: SVGs with scripts or external references render with zero network requests and zero file reads outside the document.
Unsupported SVG features (for example scripts, foreignObject, missing fonts, unsupported filters) produce a visible fidelity warning that lists them.
Annotations export as SVG that re-imports with identical geometry (golden).

requirements.title: HEIC/HEIF via OS decoders

requirements.title: Clean full image and source-resolution selection copy

requirements.title: Detail crop plus overview context package

requirements.title: Explicit transfer shelf without global clipboard recording

requirements.title: Windows clipboard, file drag and Android share

requirements.title: Large-file handoff fallback and destination tests

requirements.title: Structured per-region instructions with exact source revision

requirements.title: Windows windowed, maximized and borderless fullscreen

requirements.title: Package format and manifest schema

requirements.statement: Each package includes a prompt.md that states everything in words.

requirements.title: Local MCP server

requirements.title: Clipboard and drag fallback for chat apps

requirements.title: Agent capture grant and indicator

requirements.title: Agent result submission into Compare
requirements.statement: Agents can submit results that appear in Compare against the original package.
acceptance: submit_result attaches an image or text to its package and shows it in Compare.

requirements.title: Provider abstraction and GPT Image adapter

requirements.title: Crop-and-stitch
requirements.statement: Regional edits use crop-and-stitch at the model's resolution.
acceptance: The crop, scale and composite steps of BUILD_SPECIFICATION section 4.9.2 are implemented and golden-tested with a mock provider.

requirements.title: Out-of-mask proof
requirements.statement: Every composite proves that nothing outside the dilated mask changed.
acceptance: changed_outside is computed for every composite and must be 0; any nonzero value marks the result as an error, never shown as success.

requirements.title: Cost estimate and explicit send
requirements.statement: Each AI request shows an estimated cost and needs explicit confirmation.
acceptance: The estimated cost is shown before sending; sending needs explicit confirmation; a per-day soft budget warns when exceeded.

requirements.title: API keys in OS credential stores
requirements.statement: Model API keys live only in OS credential stores.
acceptance: Keys are stored in Windows Credential Manager and the Android Keystore; an automated scan finds no key in projects, packages, logs or evidence.

requirements.title: More providers and a candidate grid
requirements.statement: More image models can produce candidates compared side by side.
acceptance: Gemini image models and FLUX.1 Fill adapters exist; several candidates for one request show in a grid with compare views.

requirements.title: AI sends from the phone alone
requirements.statement: The phone can send AI requests directly while away from the PC.
acceptance: With internet but no PC, the phone completes the W1 loop and syncs results to the PC later.

requirements.title: Recapture the same target
requirements.statement: After an agent acts, the same window or phone screen is recaptured for comparison.
acceptance: Recapture finds the same window (or phone screen) and aligns it to the original by element IDs or image registration.

requirements.title: Per-marker before and after
requirements.statement: Each marker shows its before and after state side by side.
acceptance: Each marker shows aligned before and after crops in Compare.

requirements.title: Pass/fail and a failures package
requirements.statement: The owner marks each marker pass or fail; failures compile into a follow-up package.
acceptance: Pass/fail is recorded per marker; failures compile into a new package referencing the original marker numbers.

requirements.title: MCP verification tools for agents
requirements.statement: Agents can request a recapture and per-marker comparison themselves.
acceptance: Grant-gated MCP tools return recapture and per-marker comparison data.

requirements.title: Ghost ink local echo
requirements.statement: In remote edit the phone draws the owner's samples immediately while the host renders the real stroke.
acceptance: Local echo appears within PERF-001 latency in remote-edit mode.

requirements.title: Ghost fade and expiry
requirements.statement: Ghost segments fade once the host's frame catches up.
acceptance: Each segment fades 150 ms after the first host frame whose last_input_seq_applied covers the segment's last input event, and always within 500 ms; no ghost remains 500 ms after pen-up (no cross-device clock comparison).

requirements.title: Phone holds full local projects and works offline
requirements.statement: The phone keeps full local replicas and works without the PC.
acceptance: With the PC off, the phone opens, edits, exports and saves projects it holds locally.

When a queued phone transaction and a PC edit changed the same property since its base revision, the rule of BUILD_SPECIFICATION section 4.4 picks the winner and the losing value is written to the conflicts table (the review UI is SYNC-003).

requirements.title: Offline rebase on reconnect
requirements.statement: Offline phone transactions rebase onto the host's log when reconnected.
acceptance: vw-sim: offline queues of up to 5,000 transactions rebase with identical final state hashes and no lost or duplicated transactions.

requirements.title: Conflict review
requirements.statement: Same-property conflicts resolve by later wall-clock write and go to a review list.
acceptance: Conflicts follow BUILD_SPECIFICATION section 4.4; the other value is kept in a ConflictRecord that the owner can swap; no data is silently dropped.

requirements.title: Host sequencing and idempotent transactions
requirements.statement: The host assigns sequence numbers and applies each transaction ID once.
acceptance: A duplicate txn_id is acknowledged without re-applying (simulation with duplicates).

requirements.title: Provisional gesture channel semantics
requirements.statement: Gesture updates are ephemeral, latest-only, expiring and swap cleanly to committed state.
acceptance: Provisional state expires 1 s after its last update; GestureCancel removes it within one frame; commits swap provisional for committed without a flash.

requirements.title: Frame stream for live annotate
requirements.statement: Live annotate shows the source through addressable JPEG dirty-tile frames.
acceptance: >= 15 fps over USB for a 1440p-class window while a scripted source changes 10-25% of its area per frame (typing and scrolling); each frame carries FrameId and CaptureGeometry.

requirements.title: Low-latency HEVC stream for remote edit
requirements.statement: Remote edit streams the target through Quick Sync HEVC low-latency video.
acceptance: >= 30 fps; meets PERF-003 over USB; decode uses MediaCodec low-latency settings.

requirements.title: Lossless dirty-tile text refinement
requirements.statement: Static regions refine to lossless tiles so UI text stays sharp.
acceptance: After 500 ms without change, the visible static regions match source pixels exactly on the phone (hash compare of decoded tiles).

requirements.title: Lossless ring buffer and freeze swap
requirements.statement: The PC keeps recent frames losslessly so a freeze can swap in the exact frame.
acceptance: The ring buffer holds >= 8 recent frames within 300 MB; a freeze request returns the exact frame or 'unavailable'.

requirements.title: Krita: remote pen and pixel bridge
requirements.statement: Krita works as a remote-pen target and through a separate GPL pixel bridge.
acceptance: With Windows 8+ Pointer Input, Krita strokes vary with pressure.

requirements.title: GIMP remote pen

requirements.title: Affinity remote pen

requirements.title: Photopea and web editors remote pen
requirements.statement: Web editors in Chrome or Edge work as remote-pen targets.
acceptance: Photopea in Chrome/Edge: pointer, drawing and pressure behavior recorded in the compatibility matrix.

requirements.title: Per-editor shortcut palettes
requirements.statement: Each supported editor gets a phone-side shortcut palette.
acceptance: Palettes for Photoshop, Krita, GIMP, Affinity, Photopea and Paint send the right shortcuts (verified per editor).

requirements.title: No GPL or AGPL code in the app
requirements.statement: The app and everything linked into it are free of GPL, AGPL, SSPL, non-commercial and unknown licenses.

requirements.title: License gate in every build
requirements.statement: Builds fail on forbidden or unknown licenses.
acceptance: Adding a GPL crate or Gradle dependency fails the build with a clear message (A28).

requirements.title: Third-party notices
requirements.statement: Release builds include generated third-party notices.
acceptance: THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES is generated from the dependency tree for every release build, including bundled executables and DLLs.

requirements.title: GPL bridges isolated
requirements.statement: GPL editor plugins live and ship separately and talk to the app only over a local socket.
acceptance: GPL plugins live under bridges/ with their own LICENSE, are excluded from app builds, and communicate only over a local socket.

requirements.title: MCP endpoint hardening
requirements.statement: The MCP endpoint is local-only, origin-checked and token-protected.
acceptance: The HTTP endpoint binds to 127.0.0.1, validates Origin and requires a bearer token; the stdio bridge connects through a per-user named pipe with an ACL.

requirements.title: Remote-input grant expiry and indicator
requirements.statement: Remote input shows an indicator and expires when idle.

requirements.title: Pairing secret lifetime and code-pairing security
requirements.statement: Pairing secrets are single-use and expire; the short-code fallback cannot be brute-forced offline.
acceptance: QR secrets expire after 5 minutes and work once; replaying a used secret fails.

Codes are single-use and expire after 5 minutes; pairing locks for 10 minutes after 5 failed attempts.

requirements.title: No secrets in logs, packages or evidence
requirements.statement: Secrets never leave the credential stores.
acceptance: An automated scan of logs, packages, evidence and the repo finds no API keys, pairing secrets, MCP tokens or signing keys.

requirements.title: Pinned, documented toolchain

acceptance: Preview <= 1.5 s; full pyramid <= 6 s on the PC; phone screen fill <= 250 ms.

requirements.title: Memory with a 200 MP document
requirements.statement: Memory stays bounded with giant images.
acceptance: PC <= 1.2 GB working set; phone <= 700 MB PSS.

requirements.title: Carrier switch
requirements.statement: Switching between USB and Wi-Fi is fast and safe.
acceptance: Sync resumes <= 2 s after the new carrier becomes available (for USB tethering, from when tethering is switched back on); 0 duplicate commits. (Replayed host input after a switch is TUNNEL-008, Phase 4.)

requirements.title: Export speed
requirements.statement: Exports finish quickly and can be cancelled.
acceptance: Selection crop <= 1 s; full 200 MP PNG <= 20 s and cancellable.

requirements.title: Masked AI edit composite
requirements.statement: Composites are exact outside the mask and fast to produce.
acceptance: 0 changed pixels outside the dilated mask on every composite; local processing <= 2 s for 12 MP excluding model time.

requirements.title: Document kinds with reserved timeline
requirements.statement: Every document carries a kind and schema version; timeline is reserved for future video editing.
acceptance: The schema and protocol include DOCUMENT_KIND_TIMELINE as reserved; loading an unknown kind fails gracefully.
The asset store accepts and syncs a video file (.mp4) as an ordinary asset.

requirements.title: Shared Kotlin code stays iOS-compatible
requirements.statement: commonMain code avoids Android-only APIs so an iOS target can be added.
acceptance: A lint/build check fails if commonMain imports android.*, androidx.* (other than multiplatform artifacts), java.* or javax.*.

requirements.title: Reusable ring buffer
requirements.statement: The capture ring buffer is a standalone component reusable as a future rolling buffer.
acceptance: The ring buffer has its own API and tests independent of live annotate.

scenarios.title: Shared document with independent views
steps: Open one image on both devices; pin the PC overview.
Zoom the phone 8x and rotate it 30 degrees.
Draw a stroke, an arrow and a text label; move two objects.
From Phase 3 (G3 re-run): add a second document, bookmark a region, and switch between documents and bookmarks.
pass_criteria: State hashes match on both devices.
PC camera bit-identical throughout.
Phone camera unchanged by PC edits.
Follow-peer happens only on command.
From Phase 3: each document keeps its own per-device view; bookmarks restore the view exactly.

scenarios.title: Live intermediate edits visible on the peer
steps: Drag a handle, move a slider and draw a 3-second stroke on the phone.
From Phase 3 (G3 re-run): toggle a layer's visibility, lock it, and rotate an object with its handle.
pass_criteria: The PC shows intermediate states at >= 30 Hz over USB.
No provisional state appears in history.
From Phase 3: layer changes and rotations sync to the peer and undo correctly.

scenarios.title: Contact and hover loupe without input-gain change
steps: Use the loupe on hover and contact at all screen edges, right- and left-handed.
Replay 20 traces with the loupe on and off.
pass_criteria: Placement and edge avoidance correct.
Identical stroke geometry with loupe on and off.

scenarios.title: Precision lens editing with exact base-view restore
steps: Toggle the lens at 3 zoom levels x 4 rotations; edit inside; close.
pass_criteria: Base camera restored bit-identically.
Edits land within 1e-6 px (property tests) and <= 0.5 px (hardware) of intended document coordinates.

scenarios.title: Lens toggle during a stroke
steps: Replay 200 traces with a lens toggle mid-stroke.
pass_criteria: No connector segment, no coordinate jump, no duplicate commit.

scenarios.title: Cancellation removes provisional ink everywhere
steps: Trigger palm rejection, ACTION_CANCEL and app backgrounding mid-stroke.
From Phase 2 (G2 re-run): use the stroke, object and mask erasers; cancel one erase mid-stroke; undo the others.
pass_criteria: Provisional ink disappears from both devices within 200 ms.
Nothing is committed.
From Phase 2: erasers behave per EDIT-005; the cancelled erase changes nothing.

scenarios.title: Live annotate pins the displayed frame
steps: Choose sources with the capture picker: a window, then a monitor, then a drawn region (Ctrl+Alt+R).
Stream a window whose content changes every frame; touch the pen down 50 times; cancel and resume.
pass_criteria: Each picker source captures losslessly.
Frozen FrameId equals the last displayed frame 50/50.
Lossless swap within PERF-004.
Cancel and resume <= 300 ms.
FROZEN and age shown.
F-to-H mapping exact at the laptop's scaling.

scenarios.title: Remote drawing in a real app
steps: Draw in the harness window and each installed editor with pressure; move/resize/switch the target mid-session.
pass_criteria: No freeze on contact.
Harness pressure correlation r >= 0.95.
0 stray events to non-target windows in 100 trials.
PERF-003 met.

scenarios.title: Air Actions and barrel routing
steps: Exercise Air Actions enabled, disabled and disconnected; remap gestures; press the barrel during and outside strokes.
pass_criteria: Exactly one command per physical action.
No send, submit or apply by gesture.

scenarios.title: Giant images
steps: Open the 200 MP fixture and the long screenshot; pan the full extent; export a full-resolution selection.
pass_criteria: PERF-005 and PERF-006 met.
Exported dimensions and hash match the source region.

scenarios.title: Export preflight
steps: Export an image over 16,383 px as WebP; export with alpha; export a rotated-EXIF photo; round-trip 16-bit PNG.
Import an AVIF, a BMP and a multi-page TIFF.
Crop, rotate and apply levels nondestructively, then export.
pass_criteria: Oversize WebP refused with alternatives.
Alpha, orientation and profile handled per policy.
16-bit round trip exact.
AVIF, BMP and TIFF import; the multi-page TIFF warns.
Crop, rotation and levels export correctly; the original asset hash is unchanged.

scenarios.title: PDF and SVG
steps: Open a multipage PDF and an SVG with script and external references; annotate, zoom, select and export.
pass_criteria: Exports match the chosen fidelity.
Zero network requests and zero file reads outside the document.

scenarios.title: Handoff into real apps
steps: Copy and drag clean, marked, region, mask and context exports into Claude desktop, ChatGPT desktop, a browser chat, Claude Code and Codex CLI.
Drag an exported file into one image editor (Paint or Krita).
pass_criteria: Every destination accepts the image; text staged separately arrives intact; nothing sends without explicit action.

scenarios.title: USB and Wi-Fi transitions
steps: Switch carriers 20 times during editing, including mid-gesture.
From Phase 4 (G4 re-run): repeat the switches during remote input.
pass_criteria: 0 duplicate commits.
Sync resumes <= 2 s.
From Phase 4: 0 replayed inputs.

scenarios.title: Photoshop same-document dual view
steps: Open a document, create New Window on the virtual display at a different zoom, draw in either.
pass_criteria: Edits appear in both windows at independent zoom.
Paint behavior recorded.

scenarios.title: Photoshop bridge
steps: Get pixels and selection with explicit IDs; refine on the phone; put back a selection and a new layer; then switch documents and retry.
pass_criteria: Round trip within 1 level per pixel.
Mismatched document refused.
Layer inserted non-destructively and named with the revision.

scenarios.title: Virtual monitor with security on
steps: Install, add a display, use it, kill the app, remove the driver - all with Secure Boot and Memory Integrity on.
Place the virtual display left of the laptop screen and rotate it; inject at its corners.
pass_criteria: Watchdog removes the display <= 5 s after the crash.
Windows return to the physical display.
DPI and orientation mapping correct, including negative origin and rotation.

scenarios.title: Window states and lifecycle
steps: Minimize, maximize, fullscreen, rotate, sleep, lock, revoke permissions and close the source during work.
Capture a monitor that shows the app.
Import a short video file into a project (stored as an asset; no timeline).
View and control the phone from the PC through scrcpy; capture the phone from the PC with screencap plus uiautomator.
Try to stream or capture a display that shows the scrcpy window.
pass_criteria: No committed data lost.
States and status words correct.
The app's own windows never appear in captures.
The video asset syncs to the peer.
Phone view, control and PC-side phone capture work with no root and no network adb port.
The feedback loop is refused with a message.

scenarios.title: Hostile and edge inputs
steps: Run low-disk, malformed-file corpus, unauthorized-peer, redaction and secrets-scan tests.
pass_criteria: No crash or hang.
Unauthorized peer refused.
Redaction verified.
No secrets found.

scenarios.title: Release artifacts
steps: Build the APK, MSI and optional packages.
pass_criteria: Checksums, notices and toolchain record present.
Compatibility matrix published.
Untested items listed.
Release performance, thermal and recovery report complete.

scenarios.title: W1: masked GPT Image edit
steps: Open a 12 MP photo; paint a change mask; write an instruction; send to GPT Image; review; partially accept; export full resolution.
pass_criteria: Cost shown before sending.
changed_outside = 0.
All four compare modes work.
Exported image is full resolution with untouched pixels outside accepted areas.

scenarios.title: W2: Android app screen to Claude Code
steps: Capture one of the owner's Android app screens via the accessibility capture; place 3 snapped markers; enter instructions by voice, handwriting and typing; send to Claude Code.
pass_criteria: Package validates; resource IDs present.
Claude Code retrieves the package via MCP (and via channel push when enabled).

scenarios.title: W2: web and Windows apps to Codex and chat
steps: Press Ctrl+Alt+A on a web app in Chrome and on a Windows app; mark up; send to Codex and copy into ChatGPT desktop.
pass_criteria: UIA element refs present.
Codex receives it through App Server where supported, otherwise MCP pull.
Clipboard path works.

scenarios.title: Instruction entry
steps: Enter instructions by PC keyboard, phone keyboard, voice and S Pen handwriting.
pass_criteria: Focus follows within 200 ms.
entry_method recorded correctly for each.

scenarios.title: Offline phone with a conflict
steps: Put the phone in airplane mode; edit; edit the same property on the PC; reconnect. Separately, run W1 from the phone with internet but no PC.
pass_criteria: Rebase succeeds; the conflict appears for review; no data lost.
The phone-only W1 result syncs to the PC later.

scenarios.title: Snap-to-element accuracy
steps: Place markers on 100 targets across Android, web and Windows captures.
pass_criteria: >= 95% snap to the intended element with correct IDs.

scenarios.title: Ghost ink
steps: Draw in remote edit in the harness and in Photoshop or Krita.
pass_criteria: Echo appears within PERF-001.
Fades after the host frame arrives.
No ghost 500 ms after pen-up.

scenarios.title: License gate
steps: In a test branch, add a GPL crate and a GPL Gradle dependency; build; remove them; build again.
pass_criteria: Build fails with a clear message, then passes.

scenarios.title: Agent capture grant
steps: Call capture_window from Claude Code without a grant, then with one, then after the session ends.
pass_criteria: Refused without grant.
Indicator visible on both devices with grant.
Grant ends with the session.

scenarios.title: Verification loop
steps: After an agent change, recapture the window; review per marker; fail one; compile the follow-up; submit a result via MCP.
pass_criteria: Before/after aligned per marker.
Failures package references original marker numbers.
Submitted result appears in Compare.
